name: devdeck-monorepo
description: DevDeck — Mac + iPhone 14 OLED Coding Companion PWA

scripts.dev: concurrently -n BRIDGE,PWA -c cyan,emerald "npm run dev -w mac-bridge" "npm run dev -w iphone-pwa"
scripts.build: npm run build -w mac-bridge && npm run build -w iphone-pwa
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w mac-bridge && npm run typecheck -w iphone-pwa
